title: Improved KKT Complexity for First-Order Bilevel Optimization under Weak Lower-Level Convexity
summary: We study deterministic first-order bilevel optimization under weak lower-level convexity, allowing nonconvex lower-level objectives and without assuming strong convexity, the Polyak-Łojasiewicz condition, or an error-bound property. We consider a $δ$-relaxed Moreau-gap constraint, with $δ>0$, for the lower-level stationarity condition and propose an inexact variable-smoothing penalty method (IVSP) for computing its approximate Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) points.
